title: HandLive — web/active (both ways, no ack)
description: WEB-01 API 1 and 00-common-specs 0.7.1: the page open in the sender's foreground browser; latest wins by observed_at. Android sends it to Mac and iPhone/iPad, the Mac to Android; iPhone/iPad never send it. JSON Schema counts characters, so the WEB_URL_MAX byte limit (8 KiB of UTF-8) and the host check are also done in code; an invalid payload is dropped silently.

page_id.description: UUIDv7, new for each page (new URL); the same while only the title changes, on a WEB_REFRESH re-send and after a reconnect.

url.description: The URL as the browser shows it, fragment kept; http or https only, with a host; at most WEB_URL_MAX (8192 bytes of UTF-8, so at most 8192 characters).

title.description: The page title, at most WEB_TITLE_MAX (256) characters; absent when the browser does not expose it or it is empty.

observed_at.description: When the sender read the URL that settled (sender clock).

browser.description: Browser id of the 0.7.1 table; receivers treat an unknown value as other (0.5.1 rule 6).
